svg.font-family: Hanken Grotesk, Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Eleven domain wedges, one to a row, each with the overclaim it refuses and the rule that does the refusing. Agent action binds every material action to one admission and one side-effect class. Visual measurement blocks a calibration claim from a read-only surface. Research claim stops tier inflation from a fenced branch or a single modality. Model eval is default-deny on promotion. Optimization workflow blocks a hardware or quantum claim without a completed hardware branch. Rollout receipt keeps reward, verdict, admission and promotion as four separate records. Eval attempt is accented, because it is the one row where a correct answer is refused: a correct outcome recorded alongside ground-truth access is contamination rather than a pass. AI for science gates each promotion rung on measurement, independent reproduction and settled objections. Conservation requires a negative fixture that provably breaks the invariant. Control certificate requires every condition of its kind to be witnessed and blocks hardware validity from simulation. Competition attempt allows the overall verdict to cite only layers that executed.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: What each domain refuses to let a packet claim

g.text: Every material action carries one admission and one side-effect
class. No verdict may cite an action absent from the trace.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace
Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: A read-only colour surface may not claim a physical calibration.
Read-only stopped the writing; it never stopped the sentence.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace
Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: A fenced prover branch is not citable support, one modality caps
at hypothesis, and the rung cannot exceed the executed tier.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace
Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Default-deny. Promote is derivable only when the overall verdict
came back as a match, and any other verdict invalidates it.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace
Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: A hardware execution claim needs a completed hardware
branch. A quantum advantage claim needs the hardware claim

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace
Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Reward score, verifier verdict, admission policy and promotion
decision stay four records. None stands in for another.

g.text: A correct outcome recorded next to ground-truth access is
contamination rather than a pass. The boundary flags are

g.text: A measured rung needs a measurement, a reproduced rung
needs an independent one, and peer review needs no open

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace
Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: The negative fixture has to break the invariant, with drift past
tolerance. A check that cannot fail is not a check.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace
Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Every condition the certificate kind requires must be witnessed,
and hardware validity never follows from simulation alone.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace
Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: The overall verdict may cite only layers that ran. A fenced layer
cites the probe that proved the fence and carries no result.

svg.text: The eleven share one seam and one verdict rule, so a reader who learns to read one packet can read all of them. Each refusal is enforced on
validation rather than left to the person writing the document.
